purpose: Which test failures block the Daily Radar publication (daily-radar.yml, step 'Core deterministic tests before collection'). Read by scripts/publication_test_gate.py.
rule: Every test is publication-critical (blocking) by default. A test file may be listed in non_blocking_files only if it exercises internal tooling that cannot change published data: scheduler gates, watchdogs, agent/orchestrator queues, PMO bookkeeping, CI bootstrap. Data accuracy, statistical denominators/dates, normative IDs, source rights/paywall, verification/review, AI budget/paid outputs, queue/state/history, exports and the web snapshot always block. When unsure, keep it blocking. A listed file whose name contains a word from protected_name_fragments is ignored (treated as blocking).
